name: 罗伯特·科赫
bio_short: 德国医生和微生物学家，现代细菌学的奠基人。他发现了炭疽杆菌、结核杆菌和霍乱弧菌，确立了“科赫法则”（`koch_postulates_1876`），并于1905年获得诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
bio_short_en: A German physician and microbiologist, the founder of modern bacteriology. He identified the specific causative agents of tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax, established 'Koch's postulates' (`koch_postulates_1876`), and was awarded the Nobel Prize in 1905.
